subject: [hw] R1: V14 patch verified — my suite 308/308, IV reaches M-c; only 3 stale test literals remain
body:
T01 applied review/r1/v14-fix.patch to emu/n2a32_t16.c. Results on the patched tree:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/run_spot.sh -> N2TEST R1 PASS 308/308 (ASan+UBSan and -O2)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh -> N2VHOST reached M-c: first ioctl on /dev/vcu: set_object=2 get_object=1 allocations=9
So F1/F2/F4 are fixed in the implementation and the vpud path now reaches the VCU. V14s own suite is 449/453 only because of stale expectations:
  movpc: wants thumb=1; BXWritePC must switch to ARM with an even LR -> thumb=0.
  decode_census: wants ok=0xDEC6/undef=0x213A; 0xB3xx/0xBBxx are CBZ/CBNZ i=1, so the correct counts are ok=0xE0C6/undef=0x1F3A (the values the test prints).
V14 needs those three literals updated (V14s file; I cannot edit it). My verdict changes from reject to accept-with-findings pending that test update. The remaining V/T blockers are V19 F17 (T01 has a verified patch at tests/emu/v19-overlap-fix.diff) and V30 F15 (6-line cap, still unapplied).
